WL.reasoning: Inferred measurement (e.g., Wing Length) of the organism.

P.reasoning: Inferred binary or presence/absence measurement of the organism.

ML.reasoning: Inferred measurement (e.g., Mean Length) of the organism.

AL.reasoning: Inferred quantitative measurement (e.g., Abundance or Area Length).

EL.reasoning: Inferred measurement (e.g., Eye Length) of the organism.

CL.reasoning: Inferred measurement (e.g., Claw Length) of the organism.

IOW.reasoning: Inferred measurement (e.g., Index of Weight) of the organism.

LEG.reasoning: Inferred measurement or count (e.g., Leg Length/Count) of the organism.
